info.title: landfall
info.description: The landfall controller's API for people and their agents. Within `/api/v1`, fields and values are only added: an older client works with a newer controller.

get.description: The open requests on deployments this principal may approve or view, each saying whether they could sign it or cancel it. A request past its time is left out.

200.description: The open requests on deployments this principal may approve or view.

post.description: Signs a request with a passkey's assertion over its challenge, as the controller's page does. A token never approves.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Plain digits with no leading zero: any other way of writing a number names nothing.

200.description: The request was approved, and its deploy is queued for its host, which checks the approval again.

403.description: No grant lets this principal approve here, a session's state change didn't come from the controller's origin, or the assertion isn't one by this principal for this request: `forbidden`, `bad_origin`, `assertion_refused`.

409.description: The request can't be approved now: `request_closed`, `request_stale`, `request_expired`, `request_cancelled`, `release_not_verified`, `deployment_busy`, `host_not_ready` or `promotion_pending`.

503.description: The database is busy, so wait for `Retry-After`, or the configuration has no `[approval]` settings: `busy`, `approvals_not_configured`.

post.description: For who asked, and for who could approve it or roll back past it. It takes no body: all it can do is stop something from running.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Plain digits with no leading zero: any other way of writing a number names nothing.

409.description: The request is no longer open: `request_closed`, `request_stale`, `request_expired` or `request_cancelled`.

get.description: The deployments this principal may view, by id, a page at a time. Those they may not view are left out before the page is cut. `needs_you` is whether one has a request this principal could sign, which a token never can.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Only the deployments on this host.

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Only the deployments of this repository.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many deployments a page holds: from 1 to 100, 50 if left out.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The last page's `next_cursor`, to get the page after it.

200.description: A page of the deployments this principal may view.

get.description: One deployment: what a list shows of it, its rule, where its releases go on to and come from, and the newest 50 of its holds with a count of all. A deployment this principal can't view is never named in a promotion.

The releases the controller recorded for a deployment, each with where it stands, a page at a time: highest semantic version first by the deployment's tag pattern, then the tags it doesn't read, in string order. At most the 5,000 first recorded most recently are listed.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many releases a page holds: from 1 to 100, 50 if left out.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The last page's `next_cursor`, to get the page after it.

get.description: One release the controller recorded: where it stands and why, what to do next, where it came from, the commits it brings over the verified release below it as GitHub lists them, and its newest 20 requests and deploys. A tag the controller hasn't recorded is `404`.

post.description: Asks for a verified release to be deployed, once an approver signs it. The controller makes the intent from its own records; the client names a tag and nothing else.

201.description: The request, waiting for an approver. A rollback by someone with the `rollback` grant cancels the request it finds open.

409.description: Nothing can be asked for now: `request_open`, `deployment_busy`, `host_not_ready`, `release_not_verified`, `release_refused` or `promotion_pending`.

x-landfall-grant.request: a tag above what runs, or the first deploy

get.description: The principal, how they proved it, what they may do to each deployment they hold a grant on by this credential, and where an approver signs a request. A token never lists `approve`.
Public, as it says nothing about this controller: the same bytes from every controller of this version.

ApprovalsView.description: What waits for an approver, as far as this principal may see.

approvals.description: The open requests, at most one for each deployment.

Approved.description: A request that was approved, and the deploy it became.

deploy_id.description: The deploy queued for its host.

AssertionBody.description: A `WebAuthn` assertion, each field in base64url without padding.

client_data_json.description: The browser's client data, as hashed into the signature.

CommitSource.description: Where a release's commits come from.

CommitView.description: One commit, as GitHub lists it.

author.description: The login GitHub attributes it to by its email, which nothing verifies, or `null`.

summary.description:
The first line of its message, quoted and cut at 200 characters. Hostile: escape it
before showing it.

CommitsState.description: What is known of a release's commits.

CommitsView.description: The commits a release brings over the verified release below it.

base.description: The verified release below this one, where the list starts, `null` for none.

commits.description: The commits, newest first: the newest 100 at most.

compare_url.description: GitHub's page comparing the two, whenever there is a base.

state.description:
What is known of them. Only `listed` carries commits; every other state but `first`
means unknown, not none.

total.description:
How many commits GitHub counts between them, for a listed range: more than `commits`
holds when only the newest 100 are kept.

verified.description: Always `false`: GitHub's list is shown as GitHub gave it, and only the release commit itself is verified.

Decision.description: What the controller's watcher last recorded of a release.

DeployBrief.description: A deploy of a release, in its story.

created_at.description: When it was queued, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

finished_at.description: When it finished, in seconds since the Unix epoch, or `null`.

oneOf.description: How it went, `null` until it finished.

DeploymentRef.description:
Another deployment, named in this one's view: its id, or `null` with `unseen` for one this
principal can't view, which is never named.

deployment.description: The deployment, or `null` for one this principal can't view.

unseen.description:
`true` when `deployment` is `null` because this principal can't view it; left out
otherwise.

oneOf.description: Its newest release, `null` when none is known.

needs_you.description:
Whether that request is one this principal could sign. A token never approves, so
this is always `false` for one.

open_request.description: The number of its request waiting for an approver, if any.

oneOf.description: What its host last said, `null` if it hasn't reported it.

holds.description: What holds it or its releases undecided, the newest 50.

holds_total.description: How many holds there are in all.

oneOf.description: Where its releases go on to, if anywhere.

promoted_from.description: Each deployment whose releases come on to this one.

summary.description: What a list shows of it.

GrantView.description: What a principal may do to one deployment, now, by this credential.

can.description: What this credential may do to it: a token never lists `approve`.

last_try.description: When it was last tried, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

reason.description: Why, as the controller recorded it, quoted. Hostile: escape it before showing it.

since.description: When this reason began to stand, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

tag.description: The release held, or `null` for the whole deployment.

IntentView.description: Exactly what an approver signs, with the same JSON as the intent a host checks.

commit.description: The commit the tag points at, as verified.

digest.description: The image digest it would run, as verified.

expected_running.description: The digest the host must be running when it deploys, `null` for a first deploy.

nonce.description: The one-time value that makes an approval unrepeatable: 64 lowercase hex digits.

tag.description: The release tag it would run.

approve_url.description:
Where an approver signs a request with a passkey: the configured `[approval]` origin
and `/approvals`, or `null` without one.

grants.description: Each deployment they hold a grant on, by id.

NewApproval.description: An approval: a passkey's assertion over the request's challenge.

assertion.description: The assertion, as the browser gave it.

NewRequest.description: A request for a deploy: a tag, and nothing the controller would take on trust.

NextAction.description: The one thing to do next about a release.

detail.description: The controller's own words for it, such as the command to run.
detail.example: ask for a deploy of v1.3.0 with `landfall request`

kind.description: What kind of thing it is.

NextKind.description: What a person or agent can do next about a release.

OriginView.description: Where a verified release came from, as the controller verified it.

digest.description: The image digest its build attested.

integrated_time.description: When the transparency log took it, in seconds since the Unix epoch, if it did.

rekor_log_index.description: Its attestation's index in the transparency log, if it has one.

run_url.description: The run that built it, quoted. Hostile: escape it before showing it.

san.description:
The workflow identity in the attestation's certificate, quoted. Hostile: escape it
before showing it.

signer.description: Who signed its tag, `null` when the deployment doesn't require signed tags.

Outcome.description: How a finished deploy went, as its host said.

Page_DeploymentSummary.description: Some of a list, in its order, and where the rest begins.

oneOf.description: Its newest release, `null` when none is known.

needs_you.description:
Whether that request is one this principal could sign. A token never approves, so
this is always `false` for one.

open_request.description: The number of its request waiting for an approver, if any.

oneOf.description: What its host last said, `null` if it hasn't reported it.

next_cursor.description: What to send as `cursor` for the next page, opaque; `null` on the last one.

Page_ReleaseView.description: Some of a list, in its order, and where the rest begins.

items.description: A release of a deployment, and where it stands.

decision.description: What the watcher last recorded of it.

first_seen_at.description: When the controller first recorded it, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

seen_at.description: When it was last verified, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

next_cursor.description: What to send as `cursor` for the next page, opaque; `null` on the last one.

Permission.description: What a grant lets a principal do to a deployment.

Problem.description: A refusal, as every `/api/v1` answer that isn't a success has it.

code.description: What a client should act on: it never changes its meaning.

title.description: For people, and may change. Hostile in a client: escape it before showing it.

ProblemCode.description:
The stable codes of a `Problem`. A code never changes its meaning, and new ones are only
added.

healthy_for_secs.description: How long a release must be healthy on the deployment promoted from, in seconds.

PromotionView.description: When a deployment's releases go on to another, or came from one.

ReleaseBrief.description: A release, by its tag and where it stands.

ReleaseStatus.description: Where a release stands on a deployment. The first that applies, in this order.

ReleaseStory.description: One release, and why it stands where it does.

deploys.description: The newest 20 deploys of it, newest first.

oneOf.description: What to do next, if anything.
Where it came from, `null` unless it verified.

reasons.description:
Why it stands where it does, in order: the controller's words, with hostile text
quoted in them. Escape them before showing them.

requests.description: The newest 20 requests for it, newest first.

ReleaseView.description: A release of a deployment, and where it stands.

decision.description: What the watcher last recorded of it.

first_seen_at.description: When the controller first recorded it, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

seen_at.description: When it was last verified, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

RequestBrief.description: A request for a release, in its story.

approved_by.description: Who signed it, `null` unless it was approved.

closed_reason.description: Why it was closed unsigned, in the controller's words, or `null`.

created_at.description: When it was asked, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

RequestState.description: Where a request stands. Values are added as answers come to carry them.

RequestView.description: A request, as a principal may see it, with what a passkey signs.

can_approve.description: Whether this principal could sign it.

can_cancel.description: Whether this principal could cancel it.

challenge.description: The intent's `WebAuthn` challenge, in base64url without padding.

created_at.description: When it was asked for, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

expires_at.description: When it ends unless signed, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

host.description: The host it would deploy on.

approve.description: With an approver up to this bump: `patch`, `minor` or `any`, or `null` for never.

auto.description: Without a human up to this bump: `patch`, `minor` or `any`, or `null` for never.

RunningView.description: What a deployment's host last said about it.

busy.description: Whether the agent is running a deploy.

config_drift.description: Whether the host's configuration differs from the controller's.

drift.description: Whether what runs differs from what the agent deployed.

healthy_secs.description:
How long this release has been observed healthy, in seconds, as of `last_report`;
`null` while nothing runs or it has drifted.

last_report.description: When the host last said anything about it, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

tag.description: The release deployed, `null` if none ever was.

Via.description: How a principal proved who they are.

BadOrigin.description: A session's read that its `Sec-Fetch-Site` says another site sent: anything but `same-origin` or `none`, when it is there. `bad_origin`.

BadRequest.description: The body or the query string isn't what this operation takes, or the query string is over 2 KiB: `bad_request`.

BodyTooLarge.description: The body is over this operation's limit: `body_too_large`.

Busy.description: The database is busy: wait for `Retry-After`. `busy`.

Forbidden.description: The principal may see this and no grant lets it do that, or a session's state change didn't come from the controller's origin: `forbidden`, `bad_origin`.

Internal.description: The controller failed. Its log says how, and the answer doesn't: `internal`.

InternalOrUnreadable.description: The controller failed, or can't read this request's row: `internal`, `request_unreadable`. Its log says which row, and such a request ends by itself when its time is up.

NotFound.description: No such thing, as far as this principal may know: one they have no grant on reads the same as one that doesn't exist. `not_found`.

ReadForbidden.description: The principal may know this exists and has no grant to view it, or a session's read that its `Sec-Fetch-Site` says another site sent: `forbidden`, `bad_origin`.

SlowRequest.description: The request, its body included, took longer than the controller waits: `slow_request`.

Unauthenticated.description: No credentials, or ones that aren't good: `unauthenticated`.

session.name: __Host-landfall-session
session.description: A passkey sign-in on the controller's own pages. A state change also needs the configured `Origin`, and a read a `Sec-Fetch-Site` of `same-origin` or `none`, or none at all.

token.description: An API token from `landfall-server token`. A token never approves.
